warnings: Axes: x = grids 1-2 at 3.50; y = A-B-C at 3.50 + 3.00 (6.50). Origin A1. Two-bay by one-bay house on six columns, open ground floor (ใต้ถุนโล่ง) with a cantilevered room bay left of grid 1 on the second floor. The same main chains print on S-01, both S-02 views, S-03, A-03, A-04, A-05..A-07. Vector CAD PDF with no usable text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

Three different printed distances left of grid 1 are three different lines, all kept: 1.30 (roof edge, S-03/A-04) = 1', 1.20 (end of the ground-floor stair beam on S-02, and the outer edge on A-03/A-05/A-06/A-07/A-08) = 1'', 1.10 (S-02 second-floor outer beam line of the cantilevered bay) = 1'''. A-03's second-floor plan prints 1.20 to the same cantilevered bay where S-02 prints 1.10 to its beam line: the beams in the S-02 file use 1''' (structural plan wins on member geometry, op01 precedence); 1.20 is read as the outer wall/finish face, not a contradiction to resolve.

Stair ST-01 (A-08) prints its plan run as 1.100 + 0.600 + 1.200 = 2.900 from the B marker, with step 1 at the B end. S-02 (both views), A-03 (both views) and elevation 2 on A-05 all draw the stair in bay B-C, rising from the C side (arrow ขึ้น) to the second floor at B. Taken: the stair lies in bay B-C, so the A-08 ticks are B + 1.10 / 1.70 / 2.90 = B'' 4.60, B'''' 5.20, B'''''' 6.40 (three sheets against one on the location; the A-08 sheet is drawn in its own orientation). Which end is the foot does not change these positions. Lines flagged and scored 0.75.

Truss T1 (S-03) prints 0.750 x4 inside the 3.00 bay and 0.700 x5 inside the 3.50 bay, so its panel points are B + 0.75/1.50/2.25 and A + 0.70/1.40/2.10/2.80. B''' (5.00) is also the rafter line printed as 1.50 + 1.50 on the roof frame plan — one point, one line.
Truss T2 (S-03) prints 0.875 x4 between grids 1 and 2 — three x dummies. Its depth 0.549 and T1 depth 0.433 are member dimensions and stay on the truss elements.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-05..A-07). The two roof levels are both labelled ระดับหลังคา (+5.85 and +6.28); the value is kept in the id so the z chains can tell them apart. Top-of-beam levels +0.10 / +2.75 (S-02 BX(+X.XX) legend) and the bathroom floor +2.80 (A-03 room tag) are recorded with id null. ระดับดินเดิม (S-05) and ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-07) print no value. The A-08 stair rise 14 x 0.20 = 2.80 and the footing depths (1.00 / 0.30 / 0.35 / 0.05 / 0.05) are member dimensions and stay on their elements.

Dimension sweep covers S-01, S-02, S-03, S-05, S-06, A-03 (floor plans), A-04 (roof plan), A-05/A-06 (elevations), A-07 (sections A/B) and A-08 (stair ST-01). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-01 (notes/index text), A-09 (bathroom detail), A-10 (door/window sizes, which stay on the schedule elements), E-01, SN-01, SN-02. S-05/S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, pile spacing, section sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements.
